canonical_project: SWU Rechenzentrum II, Ulm Science Park III
owner: Stadtwerke Ulm/Neu-Ulm GmbH / SWU TeleNet; built by DC-Datacenter-Group
notes: City of Ulm reported key handover on 2025-03-27 after about two years of construction; SWU source said the Science Park III build would provide space for about 150 server cabinets. DCD reported 1,430 sqm, PUE below 1.3, and 1.6 MW backup generation.
